svg.title: The nineteen parts of Maithic
svg.desc: Nineteen cards in a grid, one for each part of Maithic, with the command that belongs to it. Platform: one command with typed errors and stable exit codes. Prove: proves theorems, automation first, then a model that reads Lean's errors. Formalize: turns a problem in words into a tested Lean statement. Review: reviews Lean files and checks every suggestion with Lean. Search: finds declarations by words. AlgoLab: algorithms drafted, tested, proved and measured. Council: several roles on one theorem with Lean as the judge. Intel: a codebase as a graph. NNV: properties of neural networks checked by the kernel. Bridge: the Lean process behind everything. Gateway: one request for three providers. Corpus: datasets traced from proofs. Guide: a small model that orders tactics. Oracle: solvers that answer with certificates. Refute: counterexamples before proofs. Bench: a benchmark with a regression gate. Blueprint: a formalization planned and tracked. Mend: repair of proofs that stopped compiling. Ledger: the audit and policy behind the word verified.
